description: This file defines base classes and data structures for observing and monitoring frame flow within the Pipecat pipeline. It provides event data classes for frame processing and transfer events, and a base class for observers to implement custom monitoring behavior.

classes.name: FrameProcessed
classes.description: Event data for a frame being processed by a processor, used for logging, debugging, or analytics.

classes.name: FramePushed
classes.description: Event data for a frame transfer between processors in the pipeline.

classes.name: BaseObserver
classes.description: Base class for creating pipeline frame observers that can monitor frame flow without modifying the pipeline structure.

methods.name: on_process_frame(self, data: FrameProcessed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle frame processing events; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle frame transfer events; to be implemented by subclasses.
